summary: Verifier: 7.0/10, NOT ON PAR (below 7.5; no blocker open). I reproduced the reviewer's numbers on the current files. Base vs Gorgewalk splash, greyscale correlation of the left 45% at 400x225: 0.895. Base vs Shadeprint: 0.509 (same plate, shifted). Rack top L* 84.2 vs hood L* 83.2 on gfx_ro_hesmi_high_base_game0.png. GLB: 15 clips, 28 joints, no spring chain. Both majors are confirmed by viewing the three splashes. The plate is shared, the figure is posterised, and Gorgewalk's boots hang over the chasm with no contact. One minor is refuted: m3. Equal L* does not merge the rack here, because the three tops sit apart from the hood with ink outlines and violet shaft bands, and they are hue-separated (b -0.8 vs 9.1). Sensitivity is clean on all three skins: a rounded, flat-crowned hood and a cloth face wrap with two lens slits. It reads as a desert wrap, not horror, a hockey mask or a mannequin. The model sits near par at the game camera; the cards hold the score at 7. Load was 6.4-9.6, so timing was not measured.

gapStatus.evidence: portrait.png and hesmi_shadeprint_portrait.png were viewed. They show two lens slits and a plain bridge, with nothing that reads as teeth.
closing_hesmi_c2r_game_x4.png shows cream linen, violet legs, brown boots and grey stone gauntlets as separate materials.
All three splashes share one plate (corr 0.895 / 0.509, measured by the verifier with sharp).

The violet shading is on the model and in the portrait. The card is a violet re-grade of the shared plate, and the pose is cast_a2 rather than the brief's overhead lift (hesmi.py:145-146 deviates on purpose).
The boots read brown in closing_hesmi_c2r_game_x4.png.
The GLB skin has 28 joints, all core rig plus x_* sockets.

The tops still read as three distinct tops (see m3 refuted), but the inlay accent does not show on her own screen, which is by design under the self token.

findings.title: All three splashes are posterised model renders on one shared vista plate
findings.what: Base, Gorgewalk and Shadeprint share the waterfall, the white spires and the domed temple, re-graded each time. The figure is a posterised 3D render, so the gauntlets and fists smear into flat blobs.
findings.evidence: art/out/fighters/hesmi/splash.png, hesmi_gorgewalk_splash.png, hesmi_shadeprint_splash.png. Verifier sharp script: greyscale corr of the left 45% at 400x225, base vs Gorgewalk 0.895, vs Shadeprint 0.509.
findings.gauge: LoL gives each skin a painted splash with its own setting, lighting and hand-rendered focal points.
findings.fix: Give each skin its own WORLD.md location plate and paint over the hands, gauntlet edges and eye-band in place of the global posterise.
findings.verifierNote: Reproduced the numbers and viewed all three cards. The plate reuse is obvious, and the major severity is fair: it is the skin-shop first impression.

findings.title: The splash staging misses the brief, and the Gorgewalk figure floats
findings.what: In Gorgewalk the feet hang over the chasm with no plank or contact shadow. Base is a hunched stoop with the fists at the waist, not a readable low-camera two-fisted stab. Shadeprint is a crouch, not the overhead lift.
findings.evidence: hesmi_gorgewalk_splash.png: the boots at about y 600-760 sit over the cliff and chasm background. CARDS at art/blender/fighters/hesmi.py:122-152 against the brief at _design/fighters/hesmi.md:180.
findings.gauge: LoL splashes ground the champion and stage a clear signature action.
findings.fix: Base: cast_a1 at the plant from a low camera. Gorgewalk: run at the contact frame on a rope-bridge plank with a contact shadow. Shadeprint: the overhead heave with the head kept forward.
findings.verifierNote: The float alone justifies the major. Shadeprint's switch to cast_a2 is a documented deliberate deviation (the ult tipped the face up), but it still misses the brief.

findings.title: The portraits are posterised, and the base hood interior shows a rust crescent
findings.what: The portraits show blotchy posterise fields, and a rust wedge above the eye-band in the base portrait reads as a scalp.
findings.evidence: art/out/fighters/hesmi/portrait.png (rust at about x 150-240, y 170-215). The crescent is absent from hesmi_shadeprint_portrait.png.
findings.gauge: LoL portraits are painted, with a cool, clean shadow inside the hood.
findings.fix: Cool and darken the hood cavity, and paint over the eye-band.

findings.title: At the game camera the face is hidden under a pale hood dome
findings.what: The eye-band is not visible from 52 degrees, so facing reads only from the fists and the rack.
findings.gauge: Hooded LoL champions keep a dark face opening or a lit eye line at gameplay zoom.
findings.fix: Darken the brim lip and the face cavity, and tilt the eye-band forward.
findings.verifierNote: This frame is a three-quarter-back view, so it partly exaggerates the issue. Minor is fair.

findings.title: On her own screen the rack tops are almost the same value as the hood
findings.what: The L* gap is 1, but the signature does not merge with the head.
findings.evidence: Verifier re-measure: rack L* 84.2 / b -0.8, hood L* 83.2 / b 9.1. The reviewer's 'b 5.9' for the rack did not reproduce. In closing_hesmi_c2r_game_x4.png the three tops stand apart from the hood with ink outlines and violet shaft bands.
findings.gauge: The signature must read on the player's own screen, and it does.
findings.fix: None needed. An optional inlay bezel could be added as polish.
findings.verifierNote: Equal value does not merge the shapes here: they are separated in space and in hue.

findings.title: No secondary motion: 0 spring joints
findings.what: There are 28 joints, all core rig plus sockets. The sash and the wrap tails stay rigid.
findings.evidence: The GLB skin joint list was read by the verifier (root ... toe.R, x_fist_l/r, x_rack_top, x_shard_mid). It has 15 clips.
findings.gauge: Recent LoL champions use cloth or strap overlap on heavy contacts.
findings.fix: Add two 2-joint chains (wrap tail, sash) with 2-3 frames of lag on cast_a2 and cast_ult.

findings.title: The rack tops barely read on the face chip
findings.what: The icon shows a pale top band with no inlay colour, and is mostly white wrap on violet.
findings.gauge: LoL icons carry one high-contrast signature element at 48 px.
findings.fix: Frame one cut top with its inlay against the dark violet field.
findings.verifierNote: Confirmed. The face itself reads well on the chip.
